findings.question: indicator K1: Is the root of the government's public key infrastructure or its qualified trust service operated by the state or a state-controlled body?
findings.quote: EFOS Typ Certifikat Rotcertifikat Swedish Public Sector Internal Root CA SAT v1 Utfärdande CA (intermediär) Swedish Public Sector Function CA v3 SAT
findings.quote_english: EFOS: Type, Certificate; Root certificate: Swedish Public Sector Internal Root CA SAT v1; Issuing CA (intermediate): Swedish Public Sector Function CA v3 SAT
findings.value: The EFOS public-sector PKI has the root certificate Swedish Public Sector Internal Root CA SAT v1
findings.title: Anslutningsinformation certifikat (Säker digital kommunikation)
findings.note: This identifies a public-sector PKI root. Its operator is the state agency Försäkringskassan (next finding). Nothing found says this is a qualified trust service. digg.se answered intermittently, but the quote was captured verbatim from the page.

review.reason: The quote lists a 'Swedish Public Sector Internal Root CA SAT v1' certificate for the EFOS test environment, but neither it nor the page says who operates that root CA.

findings.question: indicator K1: Is the root of the government's public key infrastructure or its qualified trust service operated by the state or a state-controlled body?
findings.quote: Den gemensamma IT-tjänsten E-identitet för offentlig sektor (EFOS) ger förutsättning för säker inloggning för alla medarbetare på statliga myndigheter. Tjänsten utvecklas och förvaltas av Försäkringskassan.
findings.quote_english: The shared IT service E-identity for the public sector (EFOS) enables secure login for all employees of state agencies. The service is developed and managed by the Swedish Social Insurance Agency.
findings.value: EFOS (E-identitet för offentlig sektor, E-identity for the public sector) is developed and managed by Försäkringskassan (Swedish Social Insurance Agency)
findings.title: E-identitet för offentlig sektor - EFOS
findings.note: Together with the Digg certificate page (root CA of EFOS), this supports a narrower 'Yes' for the public-sector PKI only. No state-run qualified trust service was found.

review.reason: The quote says the employee login service EFOS is developed and managed by Försäkringskassan, but the page does not describe EFOS as a PKI root or a qualified trust service, so the K1 operator is not established.

findings.question: indicator K2: Is the national electronic identity scheme operated by the state or a state-controlled body?
findings.quote: Syftet är att säkerställa att kraven i EU:s förordning om elektronisk identifiering uppfylls. Den nya lagen börjar gälla den 1 december 2026. Utskottets förslag till beslut Bifall till propositionen. Riksdagens beslut Kammaren biföll utskottets förslag.
findings.quote_english: The purpose is to ensure that the requirements of the EU regulation on electronic identification are met. The new law applies from 1 December 2026. Committee's proposal: approve the bill. Riksdag decision: the Chamber approved the committee's proposal.
findings.value: Riksdag adopted the state e-ID law (statlig e-legitimation); it applies from 1 December 2026
findings.title: En statlig e-legitimation (Betänkande 2025/26:TU21)
findings.note: Newer than the cited bill: the Riksdag adopted the law on 17 June 2026, but as of 2026-10-02 the state e-ID is not yet in operation, so the current answer is that the scheme is not yet state-operated; 'Partly' is not stated by any source.

review.reason: The quote gives only the law's purpose (meeting EU eID regulation requirements) and its start date of 1 December 2026; it does not name the body that operates the scheme or say it is state-controlled, and the page summary names no implementing authority either.
